data.name: Lunar Resilience
data.detailed_description:
A new open-world survival horror experience.

Sent to a remote and isolated island, you quickly realize something has gone terribly wrong.
The place is abandoned, nature has reclaimed human structures… and you are not alone.

Lunar Resilience is an open-world survival horror game focused on total freedom, run-based progression, and intense cooperation.

Survive as many days as you can — alone or with up to 4 players in online co-op.

🩸 TRUE SURVIVAL HORROR

There are no guided missions.
There are no markers telling you what to do.

You decide:

  • Where to go

  • When to explore

  • When to run

  • When to fight

The island reacts to your choices, and the night is never safe.

👥 4-PLAYER CO-OP

  • Play solo or with friends

  • Share resources

  • Work together to survive the nights

  • Explore the surface and underground areas with backup

  • Die together — or abandon those left behind

Surviving as a group is easier.
But it also draws more attention.

🏝️ A HOSTILE OPEN WORLD

Explore a living, dangerous island:

  • Coastline with a tourist pier, abandoned hotel, and seaside restaurant

  • Dense jungles with limited visibility

  • Ruined scientific facilities

  • Forgotten military bases

  • Dungeons scattered across the map

  • Swimmable ocean, caves, and underwater areas

No area is ever completely safe.

🧱 BUILD, CRAFT, AND DEFEND

  • Gather resources

  • Build simple shelters or defensive bases

  • Use the environment to your advantage

  • Plan where to spend the night — or pay the price

Every shelter can mean the difference between surviving… or losing everything.

🕳️ DUNGEONS AND CHALLENGES

Discover dungeons of different difficulty levels.

Defeat bosses, earn rewards, and face what lives beneath the island.

♻️ DIE. RETURN. EVOLVE.

  • Your goal is to survive as many days as possible

  • When you die, you return to the menu

  • Earn fragments based on your performance

  • Use them to permanently upgrade attributes

  • Rankings track the best survivors

Every run makes you stronger.
Every mistake teaches you something new.

⚠️ LUNAR RESILIENCE DOESN’T HOLD YOUR HAND

  • There is no right path

  • There are no easy endings

  • There are no guarantees

The island doesn’t want you to survive.
It’s only waiting to see how long you can last.

data.short_description: Lunar Resilience – Stranded on a remote island, you must craft, build, and fight to survive as long as possible. Be resilient and endure the nights alone or in 4-player co-op in this open-world survival horror experience.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I7-8700K or AMD RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1080Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain violence, blood and animal cruelty. It can be sensitive to those who are afraid of being in dense forests, darkness, high places and closed spaces. Not recommended for those with lucophobia or lycanthrophobia.
